title: week_add
description: Result of `stride week add` — the id the coach links against later. Revising an existing open date returns the SAME id, and REPLACES the prescription wholesale: omitting the target on a re-plan clears it. Target fields per ADR 0014: magnitudes are impossible-zero behind target_known.

target_known.description: True when this session carries a structured target (ADR 0014). The three magnitudes are impossible-zero fields behind this flag (ADR 0009): reps 0 cannot be a real target.
